fields.climate: highland continental, hot summers, cold winters
fields.terrain: Armenian Highland with mountains; little forest land; fast flowing rivers; good soil in Aras River valley
fields.resources: small deposits of gold, copper, molybdenum, zinc, bauxite
fields.farm: milk, potatoes, grapes, vegetables, wheat, tomatoes, watermelons, apricots, apples, barley
fields.exports: gold, diamonds, copper ore, broadcasting equipment, jewelry
fields.industries: brandy, mining, diamond processing, metal-cutting machine tools, forging and pressing machines, electric motors, knitted wear, hosiery, shoes, silk fabric, chemicals, trucks, instruments…
fields.languages: Armenian 97.2%, Russian 1.4%, Ezidian 1.0%; less than 1%: other, unknown
fields.religions: Armenian Apostolic 95.2%, not stated 1.7%; less than 1%: Catholic, no religion, Evangelical, Shar-fadinian, other, Armenian Orthodox, Jehovah's Witness, Pagan, Molokan

system.text: parliamentary democracy; note - constitutional changes adopted in December 2015 transformed the government to a parliamentary system

fields.military: 18-27 for voluntary (men and women), contract (men and women) or compulsory (men) military service; contract military service is 3-12 months or up to 5 years; conscripts serve 24 months…
